newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan buys 50,000 tonnes U.S. wheat at $178.85/T.
newsitem.headline: Jordan buys 50,000 tonnes U.S. wheat at $178.85/T.

text.p: Jordan on Thursday bought 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter or hard red spring wheat for second half October shipment at $178.85 per tonne, traders said.

Jordan bought last Tuesday 50,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for October shipment from Continental Grain at $178.80 per tonnes. It decided to delay purchase of another 50,000 tonnes to Thursday while bringing forward the shipment period to second half October from November.
Traders said Jordan purchased the wheat from Dreyfus.
